English: Dude, you've become an ass-kicking machine.

Hard to believe the boars
always chased YOU around!
H-Hey! That's when we were kids!

Remember how you woke the dead
when a caterpillar climbed in your shirt?
Oho! Good to know he hasn't changed at all!
How I weep for the future of Euclid...
...if these two are its mightiest men...
